note: The Foundation as one graph. Every edge is a Constraint Protocol edge (cp:true): the Protocol is not a slice of the picture, it is what the edges are made of. `level` on a node is the lowest reading level at which it appears (1..5); `level` on an edge likewise. The `cp` node is drawn as the substrate (the lines' colour and one legend sentence) at levels 1-2, and becomes a node that opens from level 4. `line` is the signed default sentence; a lens may rephrase a label, never the id.
